◈ MIRROR — FORGE CROSS-PLATFORM BUILD — v0.1.0
SOURCE: MIRROR v1.5 Final Corrected Package.

TARGETS
Web, macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS/iPadOS and Android through one standards-based installable PWA codebase.

RUN
python3 run_local.py
Open http://127.0.0.1:8080

IMPLEMENTED
Canonical ten-helper roster; independent/subordinate selection; persistent LCAS state; Project + Tracking project;
local persistence; JSON state export; responsive UI; PWA manifest; offline service worker; bundled MIRROR source canon.

BOUNDARY
This is the first executable cross-platform shell/control build. External AI/provider execution adapters, app-store
native wrappers, production signing/notarization, remote sync and EDEN-wide propagation are not yet implemented.
